svg.title: Quay fender — Bryggjuvarnarpúði
svg.desc: A tall rubber fender hangs from a quay wall beside the approaching side of a vessel.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Sectors and Nature","subject":"fisheries-quay-fender","label_en":"Quay fender","label_is":"Bryggjuvarnarpúði","section":"03","category_en":"Fisheries services, ports and cold logistics","category_is":"Þjónusta við sjávarútveg, hafnir og kælikeðja","batch":2,"tags":["fisheries","mooring"],"description":"A tall rubber fender hangs from a quay wall beside the approaching side of a vessel.","design_note":"A suspended vertical cushion against the quay indicates impact protection rather than a mooring fitting.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
